Extremum Error: 12.6% of 199 instances of hallucination erroneous statements include it.

The rarity of this error stems not from the fact that the LLM has strong numerical computation capabilities, but from the fact that it rarely includes insights that require numerical calculations in its summaries
Detail Omission: We identified 22.1% instances of this error, making it the most common.
Statistics indicate that among all types of hallucinations, the most common ones are Detail Omission, for which it is challenging for LLMs to generate a comprehensive summary
